contexts.text: There are atmospheres as of great pearls transparent from their centres, and shining with the brightest colours.
They would be consumed, like pearls cast into ordure or acid.
The image held in its left hand a chain of pearls.
The bridegroom... fastened... the necklace of pearls round the bride's neck.
The bracelets (of the Angel wife) were of pearls.
The Divine Trinity is like a pearl of the greatest price; but when it is divided into Persons, it is like the pearl divided into three parts...
